Ch 4 practice Que
Q1. A city has air-quality sensors installed at different locations. Pollution at one location is influenced by nearby sensors, wind, temperature, and humidity, and the pattern changes throughout the day. Analyze how a spatio-temporal graph model can be used to forecast AQI in this situation. [5 Marks]
Q2. A university wants to reduce energy consumption in its buildings. Sensors collect temperature, humidity, and electricity-consumption data. Before implementing a new control strategy, it wants to test its impact virtually. Analyze how a digital twin can support this requirement. [5 Marks]
Q3. A smart grid uses solar energy and battery storage. During extreme weather, solar generation and electricity demand fluctuate considerably. Analyze how reinforcement learning can be used to manage the grid under these conditions. [5 Marks]
Q4. A forest department uses satellite images to monitor deforestation. It needs to identify affected areas at pixel level and determine whether degradation is increasing over time. Analyze how semantic segmentation and temporal modelling can be combined for this purpose. [5 Marks]
Q5. A farm uses soil-moisture sensors, weather data, and satellite imagery to determine crop-water requirements. However, the sensor data may be incomplete or noisy. Analyze how Physics-Informed Machine Learning can improve prediction in this situation. [5 Marks]
